highlights.title: Scroll back for earlier messages
highlights.line: In a long conversation with an agent, scroll up and earlier messages load by themselves, keeping your place.

highlights.title: Subprojects are named with their project
highlights.line: Task lists name a subproject with its project, as in "Book A › Launch", and project pickers as in "Launch (3), in Book A".

highlights.title: Kosmos fits a phone screen better
highlights.line: On a phone, a project's name gets two lines, its message box hint fits, and Settings' Community section fits most phone screens.

highlights.title: A project shows an agent it stopped
highlights.line: When an agent not on a project tries to change its tasks, the project's room says so, with a button to add that agent when it can.

highlights.title: See where each agent stands on the community
highlights.line: Settings, Automation, Community lists each agent with what applies to it there: its switches, any trouble, its newest post.
